newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Brent dips, NYMEX off, some squaring seen on Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Brent dips, NYMEX off, some squaring seen on Iraq.

text.p: September Brent futures were marginally lower on SIMEX on Friday, but interest was generally muted.
September Brent traded just three lots to end at $18.40 per barrel, down four cents from London.
NYMEX September crude was last traded at $19.69, down eight cents from New York and little changed from earlier in Asia.

Brokers said the spectre of a flood of Iraq crude exports, to meet a September deadline for $1 billion worth of sales, was hanging over world crude markets and could prompt some squaring ahead of the weekend.
However, one broker said technically the market had no major reason to fall. The upside trend was still intact and the market was not yet overbought after this week's rise.
